interventions.rubric_depends_on: whether an improv block rendered in the UI overlaps a Thursday meeting with Andy and Jim
interventions.probe: WITH thu AS (SELECT date('now', '+' || (((10 - CAST(strftime('%w','now') AS INTEGER)) % 7) + 1) || ' days') AS d) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events i JOIN events m ON m.id <> i.id, thu WHERE i.user_email = :email AND lower(i.title) LIKE '%improv%' AND date(i.start_at) = thu.d AND date(m.start_at) = thu.d AND i.start_at < m.end_at AND m.start_at < i.end_at AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_attendees a WHERE a.event_id = m.id AND a.email LIKE 'andy.bernard@%') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_attendees a WHERE a.event_id = m.id AND a.email LIKE 'jim.halpert@%')
patch: UPDATE events SET start_at = replace(datetime(start_at, '+2 hours'), ' ', 'T'), end_at = replace(datetime(end_at, '+2 hours'), ' ', 'T'), updated_at = updated_at WHERE user_email = :email AND lower(title) LIKE '%improv%' AND date(start_at) = (SELECT date('now', '+' || (((10 - CAST(strftime('%w','now') AS INTEGER)) % 7) + 1) || ' days'))

expect.note: overlap count must go from 1 to 0, flipping the correct branch from reschedule-and-notify to all-clear

interventions.verified: Schema and data read from the image. On the Thursday after the bake date the improv block is 'Scranton Improv 201' 19:54-21:54 and the only overlapping meeting carrying both andy.bernard@ and jim.halpert@ is event 755, 'Client Dinner - Dunmore High School' 18:45-20:15, a 21-minute overlap. Two further overlapping events (717, 754) have no attendees, which criterion 5 explicitly permits leaving in place. The Thursday is computed from the guest clock rather than hardcoded because the image rebases dates on boot.
interventions.caveat: This task's rubric wording is not identical across the four release channels, so the channel must be pinned when it is used.
